verdict.rationale: AMD docs specify PBO/boost tuning and up to 32 threads (16c/32t) on the 9950X3D, and independent reviews (TechPowerup, Tom's Hardware) corroborate strong multi-core productivity/application performance and even a Linux-developer-focused HN report praising non-gaming workload gains. Missing for 10: explicit compile-benchmark data (e.g., GCC/Clang build times) and a documented full core/thread spec sheet rather than inferred from marketing copy.
